item.title: Lughole 0.2.0
item.description:
- **Separate instruments.** The new Stems tab splits a song into vocals, drums, bass, guitar, piano and everything else, right on your Mac. Open them as channels you can mute, solo and balance, as separate files, or keep only the parts you want (untick Vocals for a karaoke version).
- **Riff Pad.** A keyboard synth in its own window (⌘K). Play or click in a short riff, then drag it onto a channel to mix it in, or onto the new "+ New channel" row to add it as a channel of its own.
- Fixed a crash when saving a newly generated document, and one when adding a channel.

item.title: Lughole 0.1.0
item.description: - First release: a native audio editor for macOS. Open almost any audio (and the sound from video), fix voices with one click, edit channels, generate tones, and save to WAV, AIFF, CAF, FLAC, AAC, Apple Lossless, MP3, Opus or Ogg.
